result.markdown:
The best HR software for a small company depends on your number of employees, budget and whether you need just basic HR administration or a complete HR and payroll system.

For a small business in the UK, I'd start by looking at **BrightHR, Breathe HR, CharlieHR, Employment Hero and Personio**\.

My recommendation would be to prioritise software that makes holiday management, employee records, absence tracking, onboarding and HR compliance straightforward without needing a dedicated HR department.

(Best overall for small businesses)

Indicative price: from £24/month

- Holiday and absence management
- Employee records and document storage
- Onboarding and performance reviews
- Straightforward employee self-service

Ideal for companies with 5–50 employees wanting uncomplicated HR.

|--------|--------|
| 1–10 employees | CharlieHR |
| 10–30 employees | Breathe HR |
| 30–50 employees | Breathe HR or Personio |
| HR and payroll together | Employment Hero |
| No internal HR expertise | BrightHR |
